gaps.explanation: Statement p5 prints one row 'Transfers from (to) other funds': General Fund 148,549, Street Fund 72,766, Debt Service Fund (204,398), Sales Tax -, Total Governmental Funds 16,917 (net; the JSON transfers_in 16,917 is that Total, the net transfer from the utilities = p7 Total (16,917)). Detail records the transfers gross: General Fund departments p14 General 152,013 (idx of 'Interfund transfers' General) + Street Fund p11 72,766 = 224,779 in; out Community Center (3,464) p15 + Debt Service (204,398) p12 = 207,862. 224,779 - 207,862 = 16,917 = statement. The gap 207,862 is the interfund transfers the Total column nets (General 148,549 = 152,013 - 3,464 is itself netted across departments on p5). Gross vs net presentation; no fix.

No business-type line is in detail. Proprietary funds statement p7 prints Sewer Fund / Water Fund / Landfill Fund columns. Added one line per printed non-zero revenue row (operating revenues plus nonoperating interest income, federal grant revenue, gain on disposal of assets - the rows in the JSON receipts): Sewer 180,155 + 935 + 54 + 848 + 70,087 + 152,405 = 404,484; Water 240,244 + 298 + 5,051 + 104 = 245,697; Landfill 70,384 + 1,370 = 71,754. 404,484 + 245,697 + 71,754 = 721,935 = statement receipts (498,491 + 952 + 70,087 + 152,405, p7 Total).
